metas.name: Over the Garden Wall
metas.description: Two brothers, Wirt and Greg, find themselves lost in the Unknown; a strange forest adrift in time. With the help of a wise old Woodsman and a foul-tempered bluebird named Beatrice, Wirt and Greg must travel across this strange land, in hope of finding their way home. Join them as they encounter surprises and obstacles on their journey through the wood.

metas.name: Adventure Time: Distant Lands
metas.description: Based on the animated series Adventure Time, these four specials explore the unseen corners of the world with both familiar and exciting brand-new characters.

metas.name: Tear Along the Dotted Line
metas.description: A cartoonist in Rome with his armadillo-for-a-conscience reflects on his path in life and a would-be love as he and his friends travel outside the city.

metas.name: ERASED
metas.description: Satoru Fujinuma is a struggling manga artist who has the ability to turn back time and prevent deaths. When his mother is killed he turns back time to solve the mystery, but ends up back in elementary school, just before the disappearance of his classmate Kayo.

metas.name: Cyberpunk: Edgerunners
metas.description: In a dystopia riddled with corruption and cybernetic implants, a talented but reckless street kid strives to become a mercenary outlaw — an edgerunner.

metas.name: Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi
metas.description: Journey into the lives of two distinctly different Jedi from the prequel era – Ahsoka Tano and Count Dooku. Each will be put to the test as they make choices that will define their destinies.

metas.name: PLUTO
metas.description: When the world's seven most advanced robots and their human allies are murdered one by one, Inspector Gesicht soon discovers that he's also in danger.

metas.name: Anohana: The Flower We Saw That Day
metas.description: Jinta Yadomi and his group of childhood friends have become estranged after a tragic accident split them apart. Now in their high school years, a sudden surprise forces each of them to confront their guilt over what happened that day and come to terms with the ghosts of their past.

metas.name: Dug Days
metas.description: A series of shorts that follows the humorous misadventures of Dug, the lovable dog from Disney and Pixar’s “Up.” Each short features everyday events that occur in Dug's backyard, all through the exciting (and slightly distorted) eyes of our favorite talking dog.

metas.name: Win or Lose
metas.description: As a championship game looms, eight characters are thrown a curveball in their off-the-field lives.

metas.name: Maya and the Three
metas.description: A spirited princess with the heart of a warrior embarks on a mission to fulfill an ancient prophecy and save humanity from the wrath of vengeful gods.

metas.name: This World Can't Tear Me Down
metas.description: When an old friend returns to the neighborhood, Zerocalcare wants to help him find his place back in the world. But what's the right thing to do?

metas.name: Asterix & Obelix: The Big Fight
metas.description: When their druid forgets how to prepare the magic potion, Asterix and Obelix must defend the village as Caesar plots to use a Gallic law against them.

metas.name: Devilman Crybaby
metas.description: With demons reawakened and humanity in turmoil, a sensitive demon-boy is led into a brutal, degenerate war against evil by his mysterious friend, Ryo.

metas.name: Afro Samurai
metas.description: In a futuristic Japan where conflicts are settled by the sword, Afro Samurai must avenge his father's murder by challenging a powerful warrior.

metas.name: The Liberator
metas.description: A diverse, dedicated, rough-and-tumble squad of soldiers spearheads the Allied invasion of Italy during World War II.

metas.name: Dream Productions
metas.description: Riley is growing up and when her memories need some extra processing, Joy and the rest of the Core Emotions send them to Dream Productions.

metas.name: Baymax!
metas.description: Return to the fantastical city of San Fransokyo where the affable, inflatable, inimitable healthcare companion robot, Baymax, sets out to do what he was programmed to do: help others.

metas.name: Carol & the End of the World
metas.description: As a planetary apocalypse looms, a woman struggling to embrace end-times chaos searches for meaning in her last months on Earth.

metas.name: Star Wars: Tales of the Underworld
metas.description: Two outlaws must navigate the galaxy's dangerous underworld as they chart their destinies.

metas.name: Star Wars: Tales of the Empire
metas.description: A journey into the fearsome Galactic Empire through the eyes of two warriors on divergent paths.
